title: NonStationaryBrachistochrone: reproducibility package for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes
description:
Symbolic derivations, numerical verification scripts, figure-generation code, laboratory design studies, and manuscript sources for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes. The repository supports the companion studies of the FLRW and Vaidya sectors (Paper I) and of the conformal Kerr (Thakurta-Kerr) sector (Paper II).

1.8.2 - final verification for the third revision of Paper II. New checks: paper2/verification/verify_optical_planes.py (central planes of the optical data off the equator: the magnetic force normal to an inclined plane at first order in the spin, and the ordinary umbilicity of the Riemannian parts, with no umbilical point on inclined planes at second order; 35 checks, with a mutation test and an exact-metric Cartesian route); paper2/verification/verify_rule_of_two.py (relativistic rule of two in static spacetimes); paper2/verification/observational/probe_gaia_bh3.py (clock thought experiment around Gaia BH3, which replaces the Kerr thought experiment scaled to M87*: encounter clock effect, single-station circuit, companion tide under two control laws, thrust budget of an ideal photon rocket and of the static station; 31 checks). The provenance manifest of Paper II now lists the verification scripts of the third revision (rail-swept surfaces, optical planes, rule of two, observational section and appendices). Paper I cites this release.

1.8.1 - probe proposals of Paper II. New paper2/verification/observational/probe_solar_sail.py: a solar-sail clock comparison between the arrival- and onboard-cost rails at maintained energy (first post-Newtonian separation, Newtonian sail law with modulated normal force for the mother and the displaced daughters, accumulated dilation t - tau), with 38 checks. British spelling throughout Papers I and II; shortened abstract of Paper II; the abelfunctions reference now points to the archived patch; the hash of requirements-lock.txt in paper2/provenance/MANIFEST.tsv, stale in 1.8.0, is corrected.

1.8.0 - third revision of Paper II. New verification for the revised Paper II and the matching version of Paper I.

New checks. paper2/verification/verify_rail_surfaces.wls and verify_rail_surfaces_sympy.py (extrinsic geometry of rail-swept surfaces under a conformal factor, two independent CAS); paper2/verification/observational/ (physical scales, rotating benchmarks, a proposed Solar-System two-probe comparison after a Saturn flyby, a Kerr thought experiment scaled to M87*, an ephemeris bound on a locally cosmological conformal factor, and conjugate points of maintained-energy rails, with an independent Mathematica check).

Corrections. Diagnostic and labelling fixes found in pre-submission audits: the rotating tau-branch numerator in ThakurtaMetric/conformal_source_Jterm.py (which now also runs in seconds); the kinematic scope of ThakurtaMetric/rail_conservation.py; the validation table generator; the regression runner paths; two exploratory costate diagnostics marked as deprecated; configurable output directories; figure-provenance reporting. Documentation rewritten (root and project READMEs).

Reproducibility. Verified on a clean copy of this release; new sage_env/ with a pinned SageMath/abelfunctions recipe and a checking runner. Licence. The MIT LICENSE file is restored and CITATION.cff added.

The provenance digest printed in Paper II is exact in the reference environment of requirements-lock.txt.
